brand.name: HuanYa Travel
brand.tagline: Australia's Chinese Charter Platform · Transparent Bidding

home.headline2: Bidding saves you time and money
home.sub: Post your trip, get bids from verified drivers, payment held in escrow. Designed for Chinese Australians.
home.feature1Desc: Tourist's deposit is held by the platform and released after the trip. No ghosting, no scams.
home.feature2Desc: Multiple drivers bid on your trip. Prices are transparent — no last-minute surcharges.
home.feature3Desc: Drivers get notified immediately when you post. Bids appear in real time — no need to refresh.
home.ctaSub: Sign up in 30 seconds and post your first trip.
